measurementBoundary: Old and new host timing levels differ even for the identical baseline. Use within-run deltas/ratios; raw old-to-new wall-time reductions are not a causal speedup percentage. Profiling supports the attributable mechanisms, not an uninstrumented speedup by itself.

entries.investigation: The actual reviewed startup profile identifies full ordinary field-list creation/layout as the dominant application work, with roughly62400 candidate nodes versus46630 baseline nodes. Native CDP layout/script counters and self sample counts are retained; invalid CPU time deltas are not milliseconds.
entries.fix: Replace the thousands-of-tracks outer field grid with a nonshrinking vertical flex stack, preserving every ordinary named control and its row interior.
